notes: Fresh Sep 13 Toronto-morning B_V1 review of all 171 judge candidates. Every candidate was checked for entity accuracy, catalyst reality, investor materiality, novelty, supplied-evidence quality and Chinese-language U.S.-stock content potential. The pool contained unusually heavy ticker/word collisions (including PM, ML, MTCH, KT, DC, IP, TV, ICE, AG, DNA, MD and SM), which were hard-rejected. Repackaged/evergreen price forecasts and stale recaps were also rejected. Duplicate Fed, TSMC, Bitcoin-ETF, Tesla and Paramount angles were collapsed. Nine distinct events cleared the conservative gate; fewer than 20 were retained rather than padding.
